capability_profile.assurance: numerical binary64 exactness checks; not validated arithmetic
capability_profile.supported_case: two-stage scalar system with two bounded non-singleton interval controls; scalar interval invariants/guards; deterministic exactly representable affine resets; scalar linear terminal objective; complete family checked by the exact linear H verifier

environment.timing_scope: One end-to-end call includes fixture/provider setup, complete path relation assembly, LP execution, candidate-face construction, and verification of all allowed path families. Serialization, build, and rendering are excluded.
environment.warmup_policy: One excluded 10-call batch followed by seven measured 20-call batches
environment.workspace_reuse: none; fresh fixture, provider and workspace per call

evidence_limits: One host, one Release configuration, and one fixed analytic two-stage fixture.
The controls are independent and bounded; no higher-dimensional parameter polytope is measured.
No comparator, speedup, source-mapped bottleneck, application-scale result, or scalability claim.
Binary64 checks are numerical assurance and do not establish validated arithmetic.
evidence_scope: 140 completed public hybrid portfolio calls; each call assembles both two-stage H relations, solves both branches with registered HiGHS LP, constructs both tied candidate faces, and verifies both complete two-parameter families with ExactLinearHHybridFamilyVerifier

measurement.comparison: one backend and one fixed fixture; descriptive only, no comparator or speedup claim

process_cpu.attribution: process-scoped, not provider-only; unrelated concurrent process work may contribute
process_cpu.scope: process CPU accumulated across all threads during workspace creation and branch execution
